Assigned two existing tasks (Buy groceries, Schedule dentist appointment) as prerequisites to new task "Plan vacation"; saved task shows "2 prerequisites incomplete" dependency state.

issue: Blocked task edit is fully disabled instead of partially restricted
actual: On blocked task "Complete tax filing" (prerequisite incomplete), the entire Edit button/icon is disabled — clicking it produced no dialog and no change. There is no way to modify description or priority while blocked; only Delete remains clickable. Expected behavior per spec is that description and priority stay editable while title and deadline are locked.

evidence: Blocked tasks (Complete tax filing, Submit final report, Plan vacation) show a disabled complete-toggle button (grayed) and a warning label, visually distinct from unblocked tasks whose toggle button is enabled.

"Complete tax filing" (1 incomplete prerequisite) shows: Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete. "Submit final report" and "Plan vacation" (2 incomplete prerequisites each) show: "2 prerequisites incomplete".

Hovering the dashed connection line (SVG path) between "Complete tax filing" and its prerequisite triggers a Radix tooltip titled "Dependency Chain" listing the related tasks (Submit final report, Review project proposal, Complete tax filing) each with a "pending" completion status.

Hovering the "Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete" warning on the Complete tax filing card opens tooltip "Dependency Chain" showing "Review project proposal — pending", identifying the specific pending prerequisite.

Edited "Buy groceries" (unblocked): changed title to "Buy groceries and supplies", description, deadline to Aug 28, priority to Medium, and added prerequisite "Schedule dentist appointment" — all changes persisted and card now shows blocked state. Deleted "Quick task title only"; it disappeared from the list and active count dropped 7→6.

While editing "Buy groceries" (which "Plan vacation" already depends on), the prerequisite selection list did not include "Plan vacation" as an option, preventing a cycle (Plan vacation→Buy groceries→Plan vacation) from being created.

Completed eligible unblocked task "Review project proposal": it left the active list (5 active remaining), appeared in Completed view (3 completed), and header counts updated from "5 active, 2 completed" to "5 active, 3 completed" (after prior +1 active from earlier tests).

Switching to Completed tab shows only completed tasks (Reply to client emails, Review project proposal, Organize desk) with count "Completed 3"; Active tab shows only active tasks with count "Active 5".

Before completing "Review project proposal", "Complete tax filing"'s complete-toggle button was disabled (blocked). After completing its prerequisite, "Complete tax filing" became unblocked: complete/edit buttons enabled and warning changed to "1 prerequisite completed".

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves the completed dependent simultaneously completed and blocked
actual: Completed "Complete tax filing" and "Submit final report" (which depends on it). Reopened "Complete tax filing" from the Completed view — the system allowed the reopen without warning. "Submit final report" remained in the Completed tab (count stayed at "Completed 4", still styled with line-through/completed) while simultaneously displaying "Prerequisite \"Complete tax filing\" incomplete" and a disabled reopen/edit button. The dependent is left in an invalid completed+blocked state instead of being prevented from reopening the prerequisite or auto-reverted to incomplete.

evidence: Completed tasks (Review project proposal, Complete tax filing, Submit final report) remained visible and accessible in the Completed view after being marked complete, retaining full details, until explicitly reopened or deleted — never disappeared entirely.

Every task card shows title and priority badge. Description/deadline appear only when supplied (e.g. "Quick task title only" showed neither, while others showed both). Blocked tasks show a prerequisite warning label. Completed tasks are visually distinguished via "line-through text-muted-foreground" title styling vs. plain styling for active tasks.
